What Finn kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Finn's gone." Kieran looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Finn." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.

📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Finn's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

The village's quarrel was with Finn — and Finn is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Kieran, Hassan, Rosa and 2 more speak for Jesse — "Finn trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Jesse before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
